ideas.title: The 3-Second Vegetable Mind Reading Test
ideas.angle: An interactive challenge where I force the viewer to think of a specific vegetable (Carrot) by overloading their brain with fast addition. This uses the 'heuristic priming' effect where the brain defaults to the most common prototype. Viewers will comment their result if it worked or failed, driving massive engagement.

hook.en: Think of a vegetable right now.

ideas.reason: Interactive mind-reading tests (like the 'Red Hammer' glitch) consistently achieve 100%+ APV because the viewer must wait for the reveal at the end. This specific 'Carrot' variation is currently trending on TikTok and YouTube as a high-conversion comment trigger.

ideas.title: The Triangle Method for Instant Attraction
ideas.angle: A social power dynamic technique where looking at a person's eyes and mouth in a specific 'triangle' pattern triggers a subconscious response. The video instructs the viewer on how to do it and warns them of the power it holds, encouraging them to 'save this for later'.

hook.en: Look at their eyes like this.

ideas.reason: Dark psychology and 'manipulation' tips are currently the highest-velocity topics in the micro-behavior niche. The specific 'Triangle Method' has high search volume and high VVSA due to the curiosity of social 'cheatsheet' content.
sources: Joe Navarro - What Every Body is Saying

ideas.title: The Human Strength Suppressor Glitch
ideas.angle: A physical 'brain glitch' where the viewer tries to pull their fingers apart while their pinkies are locked in a specific way. It demonstrates how the brain inhibits muscle groups to prevent self-injury. The viewer tries it live, fails, and shares their experience in the comments.

hook.en: Your brain is nerfing your strength.

ideas.reason: Physical glitches (like the 'Paralyzed Finger') are the most reliable 'shareable' content. This specific test uses the 'Autogenic Inhibition' reflex, making it a high-retention 'try this now' video.
